Why full source: the strict admission method calls actual owner/retry/gate
helpers and the real ATR/reset path. A sliced reimplementation or subclass of
the new target would not be literal OLD. A complete hash-pinned baseline avoids
that shortcut while compressed size is128735bytes (about126KiB). It also avoids
requiring a private /private/tmp path, network download, unshallowed Git history
or exec-git permission in CI. No old behavior is modeled/mocked/feature-switched.

The test verifies encoded and uncompressed hashes before compiling/executing
the original module in an independent namespace. Ordinary imports resolve to
the CI checkout's common dependencies, exactly as the prior literal-old loader
did; this is an OLD core comparison, not a whole old deployment/DB snapshot.

That fixture remains blocked on the exact retained packet/line references from
C1. Do not synthesize log lines from prose, owner rows or controlled tests.
